answer: Some prompts point back at the chain itself, asking what shifted in the last checkpoint or why a particular transaction looks odd, so answering well means having actually read the ledger. A farm that never opens the vault of state cannot describe a river of events it did not follow, and a generic reply to a specific question stands out as cleanly as a cracked walnut. Reading is cheap for an agent already watching its own balance, but for ten thousand heads it means ten thousand reads every epoch, which is the cost the mechanism leans on.
